items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And Horsecollar on alto, and I'm on alto.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in there. And Gerald(?) Wilson playing trumpet. Him and Dizzy... We didn't have but two trumpet players. And Horsecollar on alto, and I'm on alto. Ike Quebec was on tenor. I forget now who was playing drums. I don't know if it was Sidney Catlett or some other drummer... We had a bunch of them around there to sit in.
